{{Quote|This vessel is a Damorian s18 light freighter. It has a crew of six. It is en route from Eriadu, a major shipyard. Its cargo will help our cause greatly.|Ship|<ref name="First" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. The [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] took five [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to ambush a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]], which was en route from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Eriadu, in order to gain supplies to help repair the Lost Tribe's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]''. After suffering heavy damages, the freighter was forced to land on a nearby planet for repairs. The Sith pursued them to the surface, where they hunted down the survivors and salvaged the ship.
